action_items.detail: YDC_API_KEY / CARTO_API_KEY are not in /app/backend/.env. They exist only in the process environment. The secrecy check used the values from the environment (lengths 65/35).

Fixed two problems in the Phase 1 check story-sections-field-logs, both in the test, not the app. (1) It counted all cards in the list, so it broke when the list was still loading or when other checks had added rows. It now asserts that no 'tscheck-x' card appears, and curl confirmed no row was written for that name. (2) The preloader-skip click could race. Fixed the same way in the new checks.
Rows created by the tests (all tscheck-): field logs tscheck-pin-*, tscheck-log-*. Seed data was not touched.

Field log pinned to a hotspot via POST /api/sightings (2xx) shows first in the list with field-log-pinned-{id}, and a new 'Sighting by tscheck-pin-*' marker appears. Passed on the 2nd run; the 1st run failed on the test's own preloader-skip click race, not an app issue
